entries.decision: Copy suggest-lsp.sh from examples/ rather than creating a new version
entries.rationale: Example already works and has tests; no need to rewrite

entries.decision: Use Bash heredoc instead of Write tool for files containing ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}
entries.rationale: Harness PreToolUse hook blocks Write tool when content contains ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, interpreting it as self-modification

entries.decision: Filed separate bug for pre-existing test_select_binary.sh failures rather than fixing inline
entries.rationale: Out of scope for marky-1vb task. Test failures are structural (JSON path mismatch), not related to hook integration
alternatives: Fix tests inline during hook work

entries.decision: Accept partial dry-run validation (only core passes) and defer full sequential publish validation to marky-hoh
entries.rationale: cargo publish --dry-run cannot resolve deps that aren't on crates.io yet. Core passing validates metadata format is correct. The actual sequential publish during release will validate the rest.
alternatives: Attempt to publish core first to unblock dry-run for others
entries.impact: marky-hoh release task must do sequential publish validation

entries.decision: Dual-transport architecture: LSP and MCP as pluggable layers over shared core
entries.rationale: Enables both editor (LSP) and AI assistant (MCP) use cases from single codebase without duplication
entries.impact: 6-crate workspace: core, parser, index, lsp, mcp, cli

entries.decision: CoreEngine trait lives in markymark-core, not a transport crate
entries.rationale: Transport abstraction (CoreOperation, CoreResult, CoreEngine) has no protocol-specific deps. Each transport crate converts protocol types internally.
entries.impact: 6 crates instead of 7. No cross-protocol dependencies.

entries.decision: tower-lsp-server v0.23 (community fork) over stale tower-lsp v0.20
entries.rationale: Original hasn't been updated since Aug 2023. Fork is actively maintained (Biome, Oxc, Veryl use it), supports edition 2024.
entries.impact: Import paths use tower_lsp_server::, ls_types not lsp_types

entries.decision: rmcp (official Rust MCP SDK) over async-mcp
entries.rationale: rmcp is official from modelcontextprotocol org (v0.13.0), has #[tool] macros, multi-transport support. async-mcp was small community crate.
entries.impact: Workspace schemars pinned to 1.2 for rmcp compatibility

entries.decision: FULL text document sync mode (not INCREMENTAL) for v1 LSP server
entries.rationale: FULL sync is simpler — each change replaces entire document text. INCREMENTAL requires precise byte-offset/UTF-16 arithmetic. Can upgrade later if performance requires it.
entries.impact: did_change handler takes last content change. ServerState replaces entire text, re-parses, re-indexes.

entries.rationale: Testing LanguageServer trait methods requires LSP service running. Separating state and conversions lets tests exercise core logic directly without transport.
entries.impact: Tests exercise convert and state directly. Server module is thin adapter.

entries.decision: Use slugify(heading.text) for duplicate slug detection, not heading.slug
entries.rationale: DocumentIndex pre-deduplicates slugs (details, details-1, details-2), so heading.slug is always unique by construction. Must compute base slug from raw text to detect duplicate heading text.

entries.decision: Drop read lock before async client.publish_diagnostics() call
entries.rationale: Holding RwLock read guard across await point causes deadlocks if didChange tries to acquire write lock concurrently. Scope the read lock, collect diagnostics into local Vec, then call async method after lock dropped.
entries.impact: Pattern used for all publish_diagnostics calls in didOpen, didChange, didClose.

entries.decision: CoreEngine trait in markymark-core, MCP routes through forwarding facade
entries.rationale: Shared operation trait codified in core de-risks transport divergence. Each transport is a thin adapter.
alternatives: Duplicate operation handling in mcp crate

entries.decision: RuntimeEngine validates roots and indexes markdown at startup, skips unreadable files
entries.rationale: Startup-time indexing makes tools behavior-complete. Failure isolation ensures one bad doc can't crash the MCP service.
alternatives: Move indexing into each tool call

entries.decision: Rewrite extract_xml_tags as single-pass stack tokenizer instead of multi-regex
entries.rationale: Copilot review found 4 bugs in two-pass regex: quadratic perf, self-closing nesting bug, > in attribute values, unnecessary allocation. Stack tokenizer fixes all simultaneously.
entries.impact: extract_xml_tags() is O(n) single-pass. Still uses regex only for attribute parsing within a tag.
